content.title: Israeli Military Launches Rare Ground Operation in Gaza Beyond Yellow Line
content.caption: Israeli ground forces launch a rare operation in Gaza, targeting a 'terror tunnel' west of the Yellow Line, as Hamas condemns the incursion as a 'flagrant' ceasefire violation.

slides.heading: Israeli Military Launches Rare Ground Operation in Gaza Beyond Yellow
slides.text: Israeli ground forces launch a rare operation in Gaza, targeting a 'terror tunnel' west of the Yellow Line, as Hamas condemns the incursion as a 'flagrant' ceasefire violation.

slides.heading: Incursion Details
slides.text: The operation aims to dismantle a 'terror tunnel' west of the Yellow Line, which marks the more than 60% of Gaza occupied by Israel.

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: The operation is condemned by Hamas as a 'flagrant' ceasefire violation, with violence continuing in Gaza over the past 13 months.
